purpose: Test whether the direction and persistence of the ATR path before an MA breakout, plus breakout-day range expansion, separates subsequent continuation more clearly than the prior historical-volatility-percentile classification.

data.market: all Binance USD-M perpetual contracts present in the frozen source union; no crypto-only or hand-selected symbol filter
data.timeframe: complete UTC 1d bars causally aggregated from audited 15m bars
data.source_contract: P0R2 priority union of Binance Vision monthly and immutable Binance API legacy partitions

causal_features.atr20: simple mean of true range over 20 complete daily bars
causal_features.atr_change_percentile_60: causal percentile of pre_breakout_atr_change_10d in the same symbol and continuous block over the trailing 60 observations including the current pre-breakout measurement
causal_features.atr_path_persistence: share of the ten ATR20 daily changes ending at t-1 that have the same sign as the ten-day ATR change

atr_path_styles.persistent_contraction: Q1_FAST_CONTRACTION and at least 7 of the 10 ATR20 daily changes ending t-1 are negative
atr_path_styles.persistent_expansion: Q5_FAST_EXPANSION and at least 7 of the 10 ATR20 daily changes ending t-1 are positive

pre_registered_views: MA-slope-aligned events by five ATR-path styles
MA-slope-aligned events by five ATR-path styles and three breakout-day styles
persistent contraction and persistent expansion subsets

historical_rv_comparison.condition: MA-slope-aligned MA7 events having both P2 ATR-path style and P1/P0 rolling-252 RV percentile
comparison_metrics: mean median win rate and two-way clustered confidence interval

slices: point-in-time Top20 liquidity versus long tail
